description: This file defines the Subordinate Data Transfer Object (DTO) class used within the HRM system to represent subordinate employees, including methods for serialization and retrieving subordinate-specific data, particularly reporting methods.

classes.name: Subordinate
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object representing a subordinate employee, capable of normalizing subordinate data and retrieving reporting methods based on employee hierarchy.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor accepting an employee number to initialize the subordinate object.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts subordinate data into an array based on specified fields.

methods.name: callGetterOnItem
methods.description: Handles specific field retrievals, particularly reporting methods for subordinates.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping of fields to their getter methods for normalization.
